page.layout: One column of text on the page; page number at top right; running head "CAPVT VI" centred above the text. No margin notes. Verse numbers sit in the text at line starts.

main_text.l: tradidi in manum tuam Iericho, & re-
septem cornua arietina ante arcā: Die
cidet murus vrbis sub se: populus verò ascendet

page.notes: Verse numbers 1–5 are printed at the start of each verse. The drop-cap I at the start of verse 1 is a large woodcut initial, transcribed as "Ericho" with the initial omitted, as the printed text reads "Ericho". Text is as printed; the word "Ericho" in verse 1 stands with its initial letter as a decorated capital.
